Are you a Level 1 or Level 2 Builder?
 ⁠
 Level 1 Builders build for themselves. The app works on YOUR laptop, solves YOUR problem. AI made this part fast, and most people stop here.⁠
 ⁠
Level 2 Builders build for OTHER people. And that's where everything breaks, and always in the same two places: database connections and deployment.⁠
 ⁠
Because AI made getting to Level 1 fast. It did NOT make getting to Level 2 safe. Two completely different problems, and we've only been solving one of them.⁠
 ⁠
That's where Retool comes in, you bring what you already built and it automatically inherits your org's security, database credentials, SSO, and permissions. You see exactly what data your app touches, edit the code directly when something breaks, trace everything end to end.⁠

videos.title: Tokens Explained
videos.description:
Your AI isn't getting dumber mid-conversation. It's running out of tokens 💀⁠
⁠
Tokens are the currency of AI. Every model reads and writes in chunks (~¾ of a word). "Unbelievable" is actually THREE tokens: un + believ + able.⁠
⁠
Every AI cost, speed limit, and "context window" you've ever hit? That's a token limit in disguise.⁠
⁠
So next time ChatGPT suddenly feels worse halfway through a convo, now you know why.⁠
⁠
